en: I see.
Very well,
do come and visit my house sometime.
As for that sort of thing,
I would be glad to tell you as much as you like.
My name is Emmy. And yours?
Until we meet again,
Cleaning up afterwards is such hard work,
There is quite a lot of it, after all.
Well said.
If livestock suffer, so does their owner.
Indeed. Livestock should be well looked after.
Emmy
I shall take good care of you as well.
Eeeeek
Is something the matter...?
Winter preparations are in full swing now.
I'm in a hurry, so
finish my winter preparations
note: continues #2359 (slice 029): needs 'I really must hurry and' before it; + '...' (#66)

en: It's been getting really cold lately,
so take care.
I've been so busy during the day lately,
so I rest quietly whenever I'm at home.
Would you please let me rest?
I'm resting at the moment.
I was just about to have tea.
Some sweets just came out of the oven,
care to join me?
Do stay and relax a while, for once.
I'm making hay right now.
I have to get it all done on a fine day like this,
so I'm busy.
How I envy people with free time
like yourself.
By rights,
I should have gotten it all done in summer,
but I didn't.
Somehow it got to be this late in the year.
Still, I can't just leave it undone,
oh, what a lot of work
Say, do you think it will rain?
I need it to stay clear a little longer.
It must be hard work. Even the little things.
Really, you stuck it out right to the end, didn't you.
Yes, very much.
Compared to where I lived before,
it's all quite different.
A very sheltered young gentleman, it seems.
I'm Emmy. And you?
Is that so? Well, come by my place sometime.
I can tell you as much as you want.
To think of your good is my very joy.
For some reason I keep getting the prices wrong...
Hello there. What do you want?
This is our house.
I'm Luisa, and my husband is Lehn.
I keep the shop open during the day,
so come back then if you need something.
Come by when the shop's open, will you?
You don't look like you're from around here,
but you're not a traveler either, are you?
Do you want something from us?
The shop isn't open yet.
You've come at a good time.
I'm just taking a rest. Care to join me?
Come back again, now.
Oh, this is the inn, you see,
but over here I sell sundries.
I'm Luisa,
note: continues in #2469 (msg 119603) and #2489 (msg 119943, slice 031): 'and my husband Lehn runs the inn.'

en: and my husband Lehn runs the inn.
Buttons, combs, pens, ink, paper.
You're better off buying that sort of thing.
Come here when you need it.
This is my general store.
I rent a corner of the inn.
Someone like you can write, can't you?
Go on, write a letter.
Look, I've got pens and ink right here.
I sell furs and lace and the like, too.
Why not buy some for the ladies?
